# Thinking Orbs DSH reference package

Language: Russian.

Registers the `thinking-orbs-integration` reference Skill. It grants no tools and includes no upstream code, documentation, data, examples, or assets. See the project’s [.docs/ru/guide/setup.md](https://github.com/tonulls/dsh-plugins/blob/tonulls/dsh-%5Bname%5D-tonulls/dsh-thinking-orbs-tonulls/.docs/ru/guide/setup.md) for installation and use; read the [lifecycle guide](https://github.com/tonulls/dsh-plugins/blob/tonulls/dsh-%5Bname%5D-tonulls/dsh-thinking-orbs-tonulls/.docs/ru/guide/lifecycle.md) for startup, verification, update/restart, disable/stop limits, and removal. See [UPSTREAM.json](UPSTREAM.json) for source evidence.

## Автоподбор

Автоподбор выключен по умолчанию для каждого Agent. Используйте `/dsh-thinking-orbs-tonulls on` и `/dsh-thinking-orbs-tonulls off`; прямой вызов Skill остаётся доступен.

🛠️ Модифицировано с помощью Codex
